adoctra

An AsciiDoc processor and publishing toolchain, written in Rust.

Note
 AsciiDoc is a registered trademark of the Eclipse Foundation, Inc. This project is an independent processor of the AsciiDoc markup language and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Eclipse Foundation or the Asciidoctor project.

Workspace layout

  • adoctra-core — parser and document model (backend-agnostic)

  • adoctra-html — HTML5 backend

  • adoctra-docx — DOCX backend (scaffold; wire up docx-rs)

  • adoctra-json — JSON/ASG backend, useful as a TCK adapter

  • adoctra — umbrella crate, backends behind feature flags

  • adoctra-cli — the adoctra command-line tool

Build

cargo build
cargo test
cargo run -p adoctra-cli -- README.adoc --to html --stdout

Compatibility work

The reference version and current limitations are described in Compatibility. The accepted implementation steps and current progress are tracked in Implementation plan. The source identity and attribute context APIs are described in Parser API.
